name: Defeating Prompt Injections by Design (CaMeL)
publisher: Debenedetti et al., Google DeepMind. Extracts control flow and data flow from the TRUSTED query so retrieved data can never influence program flow, and enforces security policy at tool calls via capabilities. 77% of AgentDojo tasks solved with provable security vs 84% undefended - the utility cost is measured, not asserted.
